title: 'Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru?' Announces Additional Cast
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nazuna Miki 's Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru? ( So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? ) manga unveiled additional cast and the theme song artists on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in October 2026.

Cast Albert: Natsuki Hanae ( Tokyo Ghoul ) Izuizu: Hiro Shimono ( Kimetsu no Yaiba ) Tenchikaibyaku: Yukari Tamura ( Higurashi no Naku Koro Ni )

Singer-songwriter Sou will perform the opening theme and J-rock band AHUB will perform the ending theme.

Ryouta Kawahara ( Hikaru ga Shinda Natsu episode director) is helming the anime at Bakkka . Yuuichirou Momose ( Maou 2099 ) is handling the series composition and script. Hiroyuki Saita ( Cardfight!! Vanguard: overDress ) is designing the characters, while Takenoko Boy ( Tensei Akujo no Kuro Rekishi ending song arrangement) is composing the music.

Miki ( Botsuraku Yotei no Kizoku dakedo, Hima Datta kara Mahou wo Kiwametemita ) began serializing the fantasy manga in Tonari no Young Jump in February 2020, with illustrations by Tsukasa Araki . Shueisha released the 14th volume on March 18, with the 15th volume scheduled for a September 17 release.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English in March 2022 and released the ninth volume in November 2025. The tenth volume is scheduled to be released on May 26.
author: MyAnimeList

title: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? Anime Reveals More Cast, Theme Song Artists
content:
The staff for the television anime of writer Nazuna Miki and artist Tsukasa Araki 's So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? ( Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru? ) manga announced three more cast members and the theme song artists on Wednesday. Music artist Sou is performing the anime's opening theme song, and four-piece band AHUB is performing the ending theme song.

The newly announced cast members are:

Natsuki Hanae as Albert, the third prince of the human empire, who used his skill "Eighth Time's the Charm" to corner the Demon King

Hiro Shimono as Izuiizu (character name romanization not confirmed), a small dragon that crash-landed in the Goblin Forest

Yukari Tamura as Tenchi Kaibyaku (literally, Creation of Heaven and Earth), a being with unknown identity, who harms goblins and humans it encounters without hesitation

Yen Press publishes the manga in English and describes the story:

Office worker Akira Yagami's altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira's newfound powers let him defy the species' normal life span...and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever!

The anime stars:

• Kikunosuke Toya as Akira

• Yōko Hikasa as Karen

• Azusa Tachibana as Chloe

• Banjō Ginga as Simon

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Eirene

• M.A.O as Dike

• Wakana Kuramochi as Eunomia

Ryūta Kawahara ( The Summer Hikaru Died , Orange , 86 , Blend S episode director) is directing the anime at BAKKKA . Yūichirō Momose ( So I'm a Spider, So What? , Africa Salaryman ) is in charge of the series scripts, Hiroyuki Saita ( Cardfight!! Vanguard Divinez , Cardfight!! Vanguard overDress , Revue Starlight ) is designing the characters, Hiroto Morishita ( Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear , Wistoria: Wand and Sword two seasons) is the sound director, and Takenoko Boy ( The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess ending song arrangement, composition, and lyrics) is composing the music at INCS Toenter .

The anime will premiere in October.

The manga launched on Shueisha 's Tonari no Young Jump website in 2020. Shueisha published the manga's 14th compiled book volume on March 18, and will publish the 15th volume on September 17. Yen Press published the 10th volume in English on May 26.
author: ANN

title: 'Doko yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e' Unveils Additional Cast, Theme Song, Main Trailer
content:
The official website of the Doko yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e ( To You in the Beyond ) movie unveiled additional cast, the main visual (pictured right), and trailer on Wednesday. The anime movie adapting Akiko Abe 's mystery romance novel was previewed at Anime Expo on July 4 and will open in Japanese theaters on October 9.

Cast Tamaki Mishima: Sumire Uesaka ( Make Heroine ga Oosugiru! ) Shuuji Aiba: Wataru Hatano ( Fate/strange Fake ) Akimitsu Yano: Nobuhiko Okamoto ( Akujiki Reijou to Kyouketsu Koushaku ) Yoshiki Suka: Yoshitsugu Matsuoka ( Chou Kaguya-hime! )

Singer-songwriter Tota ( Anne Shirley ) is performing the theme song "Olive," which is featured in the trailer below.

Junichi Wada ( Nagato Yuki-chan no Shoushitsu ) is helming the anime at TMS Entertainment . Sayaka Kuwamura ( Josee to Tora to Sakana-tachi ) is penning the script. Fumi Katou ( Ame wo Tsugeru Hyouryuu Danchi ) is designing the characters, while Kouji Nakamura ( Eureka Seven AO ) is composing the music.

Abe wrote the novel under Shueisha's Orange Bunko imprint in October 2017, featuring illustrations by syo5 .

Haruka Chino began drawing a manga adaptation in Tonari no Young Jump magazine in August 2025. The first volume went on sale on February 19.

Main Trailer

title: Studio Cabana Gets Anime in 2027
content:
Studio Cabana is getting an anime adaptation set to premiere in 2027. A teaser visual was released along with the staff and cast information. JUVENAGE ( Kusunoki’s Garden of Gods ) will animate the series.

Shinichiro Ushijima ( UniteUp! ) is directing with Sawako Hirabayashi ( I’ll Become a Villainess Who Goes Down in History ) writing the scripts. Haruka Sagawa ( Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 ) is the character designer. Sayumi Suzushiro (Nijika Ijichi in Bocchi the Rock! ) will be voicing the main character Yukari Maki. Agri Uma writes and illustrates the manga, which began serialization in June 2021 on the Pixiv Comic website under ASCII Media Works’ Pixiv Sylph. To commemorate the manga receiving an anime adaptation, Uma released an illustration:

Yen Press will release the manga in English, describing it as: Yukari Maki is a high-school girl who prides herself on honesty—and she’s starting to get the feeling that she and her delinquent classmate, Yusuke Kusaka, don’t have a single thing in common! But her straitlaced unwillingness to let him skate by in school earns her an almost chaperone-like reputation, much to Yusuke’s apparent disdain. Yet, despite his disdain for her hovering, Yukari is unwilling to let a new rumor about Yusuke spread. After following him home to discuss it, she watches him stop at a music studio. And in there, Yukari sees—and hears—a side of Yusuke she had never imagined… Source: Official Website , X (formerly Twitter) ©Agri Uma/KADOKAWA/“Studio Cabana” Production Committee

title: Agri Uma's Studio Cabana Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
Kadokawa announced on Wednesday that Agri Uma 's Studio Cabana manga is inspiring a television anime next year.

Sayumi Suzushiro plays protagonist Yukari Maki, reprising her role from a 2022 promotional video for the manga.

The staff did not announce the cast for Yūsuke Kusaka, but presented the visual for the character:

Shin'ichirō Ushijima ( I want to eat your pancreas , UniteUp! , UniteUp! -Uni:Birth- ) is directing the anime at JUVENAGE . Sawako Hirabayashi ( Wolf Girl & Black Prince , Delicious Party♡Precure , Dengeki Daisy ) is in charge of the series scripts. Haruka Sagawa ( Call of the Night , Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- season 3 and 4) is designing the characters.

Yen Press licensed the manga, and will begin releasing it in winter 2027. Yen Press describes the manga:

Yukari Maki is a high school girl who prides herself on honesty—and she's starting to get the feeling that she and her delinquent classmate, Yusuke Kusaka, don't have a single thing in common! But her straitlaced unwillingness to let him skate by in school earns her an almost chaperone-like reputation, and his apparent disdain. Yet, despite Yusuke's disapproval of her hovering, Yukari refuses to let a new rumor about him spread. After following Yusuke home to discuss it, she watches him stop at a music studio. And there, Yukari sees—and hears—a side of Yusuke she had never imagined…

Uma launched the manga in Kadokawa 's pixiv Sylph online magazine in June 2021. Kadokawa published the manga's eighth compiled book volume in November 2025, and will release the ninth volume on August 21.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Studio Cabana' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
Production company Kadokawa opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Aguri Uma 's Studio Cabana on Wednesday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime series will air in 2027.

Voice actress Sayumi Suzushiro ( Bocchi the Rock! ) is starring as the lead female character Yukari Maki.

Staff Director: Shinichirou Ushijima ( Kimi no Suizou wo Tabetai ) Series Composition: Sawako Hirabayashi ( Ookami Shoujo to Kuro Ouji ) Character Design: Haruka Sagawa ( Yofukashi no Uta ) Studio: Juvenage

Uma began drawing the music romance manga on the pixiv Sylph web magazine in June 2021. Kadokawa published the eighth volume in November 2025, with the ninth scheduled to be released on August 21. Studio Cabana has a cumulative 500,000 copies of its volumes in circulation.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English on May 25 and plans to release the first volume on December 15.

Studio Cabana was nominated in the Web Manga category for the 2023 Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Awards (Next Manga Awards).

Synopsis Yukari Maki is a high school girl who prides herself on honesty—and she's starting to get the feeling that she and her delinquent classmate, Yuusuke Kusaka, don't have a single thing in common! But her straitlaced unwillingness to let him skate by in school earns her an almost chaperone-like reputation, and his apparent disdain. Yet, despite Yuusuke's disapproval of her hovering, Yukari refuses to let a new rumor about him spread. After following Yuusuke home to discuss it, she watches him stop at a music studio. And there, Yukari sees—and hears—a side of Yuusuke she had never imagined... (Source: Yen Press)

title: ippatu's Shōjōhime Manga Moves to YanMaga Web on August 2
content:
This year's 34th issue of Kodansha 's Young Magazine announced on Tuesday that ippatu 's Shōjōhime (Monkey Princess) manga will move to Kodansha 's YanMaga Web website, where it is simultaneously serialized, on August 2. The manga will also start its new arc in its next chapter.

The manga simultaneously launched in Young Magazine and on the YanMaga website in December 2025. The manga is a new interpretation of the Chinese classic Journey to the West. Kodansha published the manga's first compiled book volume on April 6 and the second volume on July 6.

ippatu began drawing the Tsugumi Project ( Tora Tsugumi ) manga, and French publishser Ki-oon began releasing it as an original manga in France in 2019. Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine began serializing the manga in Japan in January 2021. The manga ended in September 2023, and got an epilogue chapter. Kodansha published the manga's seventh and final volume in November 2023. Kodansha USA Publishing licensed the manga and released the final volume in September 2025, and it shipped in France in February 2024.

Tsugumi Project is inspiring a television anime adaptation.

title: 'Mahou no Princess Minky Momo: Akogare no Yume e - Magokoro no Duo' Reveals Additional Cast, Teaser Trailer
content:
The official website for the new Mahou no Princess Minky Momo: Akogare no Yume e - Magokoro no Duet ( Fairy Princess Minky Momo ) original video anime revealed additional cast members, main visual (pictured), and a teaser trailer on Wednesday. The OVA is scheduled to open in theaters on November 13 ahead of its home video release.

Cast Databook: Fukuchi Ochiai ( Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san ) Chamocha: Natsumi Fujiwara ( Saikyou no Ousama, Nidome no Jinsei wa Nani wo Suru? ) Pipirupi: Rie Kugimiya ( Gintama )

Ayumu Watanabe ( Summertime Render ) is directing at Ashi Productions and Deko Akao ( Witch Watch ) is penning the script. Hiroshi Watanabe ( Minky Momo in Tabidachi no Eki ) and Mari Tominaga ( Cardfight!! Vanguard ) aare designing the characters. Tomoki Hasegawa ( Jiisan Baasan Wakagaeru ) is composing the music.

Produced by Ashi Productions, the original television anime aired in 63 episodes from March 1982 to May 1983. A second anime series aired in 62 episodes from Fall 1991 to Fall 1992.

The Minky Momo in Yume ni Kakeru Hashi ( Minky Momo in the Bridge Over Dreams ) original video anime was released in May 1993, followed by Yume no Naka no Rondo ( La Ronde in my Dream ) in July 1985, and Minky Momo in Tabidachi no Eki ( Minky Momo: The Station of Your Memories ) in June 1994.

title: To You in the Beyond Anime Film's Trailer Unveils Theme Song, More Cast
content:
The official website for To You in the Beyond , the anime film of Akiko Abe 's Doko Yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e novel, unveiled the full trailer, key visual, theme song artist, and more cast members on Wednesday.

The trailer previews the theme song "Olive" by musician Tota .

The newly announced cast members include (from left to right in the image below):

• Sumire Uesaka as Tamaki Mishima, Kazuki and Nao's classmate and honors student

• Wataru Hatano as Shо̄ji Aiba, a generous, sincere boy

• Nobuhiko Okamoto as Akimitsu Yamu, Kazuki's friend

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Yoshiki Suga, who treats Kazuki like a rival

Previously announced cast members include:

Hiiro Ishibashi as the protagonist Kazuki Tsukigase

Anna Nagase as Nao Akishika, a mysterious girl

Simba Tsuchiya as Mikiya Ozaki, Kazuki's classmate

Hiroshi Tamaki as Kōzu, who holds the key to the story

Naohito Fujiki as Nishina, Kazuki Tsukigase's homeroom teacher who watches over him

The film will open in Japan on October 9. (Production companies Shochiku and Pony Canyon report that "international release details" will be announced later.)

The novel's story centers on a boy named Kazuki Tsukigase, who transfers to a high school on a remote island to get away from anyone who knows him. Kazuki finds out that there is an inlet on the island where people are rumored to disappear. Exploring the inlet, he encounters an unconscious girl. When she comes to after Kazuki takes her to the clinic, she is unable to give out anything about her identity except that she is named Nao, is 16 years old, and whispers the year "1974."

Junichi Wada ( HIGH CARD ) is directing the anime at TMS Entertainment , and Sayaka Kuwamura ( Strobe Edge , Josee, The Tiger and the Fish ) wrote the screenplay. Hechima ( Cosmic Princess Kaguya! ) is serving as character designer and chief animation director. Kōji Nakamura is composing the music. Shochiku is distributing the film.

The film will open in Japan on October 9. (Production companies Shochiku and Pony Canyon report that "international release details" will be announced later.)

Abe and Shueisha released the book in October 2017, with art by syo5 .

Haruka Chino launched a manga adaptation of the novel on Shueisha 's Tonari no Young Jump website in August 2025. Shueisha released the manga's first compiled book volume on February 19.

contentBlocks.text: The film will open in Japan on October 9. (Production companies Shochiku and Pony Canyon report that "international release details" will be announced later.)

The novel's story centers on a boy named Kazuki Tsukigase, who transfers to a high school on a remote island to get away from anyone who knows him. Kazuki finds out that there is an inlet on the island where people are rumored to disappear. Exploring the inlet, he encounters an unconscious girl. When she comes to after Kazuki takes her to the clinic, she is unable to give out anything about her identity except that she is named Nao, is 16 years old, and whispers the year "1974."

Junichi Wada ( HIGH CARD ) is directing the anime at TMS Entertainment , and Sayaka Kuwamura ( Strobe Edge , Josee, The Tiger and the Fish ) wrote the screenplay. Hechima ( Cosmic Princess Kaguya! ) is serving as character designer and chief animation director. Kōji Nakamura is composing the music. Shochiku is distributing the film.
The film will open in Japan on October 9. (Production companies Shochiku and Pony Canyon report that "international release details" will be announced later.)
Abe and Shueisha released the book in October 2017, with art by syo5 .
Haruka Chino launched a manga adaptation of the novel on Shueisha 's Tonari no Young Jump website in August 2025. Shueisha released the manga's first compiled book volume on February 19.

title: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters Soccer Game's Trailer Introduces South Korean Team
content:
Bandai Namco Entertainment revealed a new trailer on Monday for Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters , a new soccer game based on Yōichi Takahashi 's Captain Tsubasa manga, introducing the South Korean team.

The game will launch on August 28 for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .

Pre-orders for the game will include a bonus 2026 Japan National Team Jersey, the World Youth Jersey, and the Early Unlock Pack. The Ultimate Edition will include five uniforms, two exclusive main menu themes, three ball customizations, the season pass, and more.

The game will feature 22 national teams, and over 110 playable characters.

Takahashi's original 37-volume Captain Tsubasa manga ran in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 1981 to 1988, and it inspired four television anime series, four anime films, several original video anime ( OVA ) projects, and a stage play . The manga is available in about 20 countries.

The Captain Tsubasa: Rising Sun manga revolves around Tsubasa as he aims to participate in the Olympics as a representative from Japan. Takahashi launched the manga in Shueisha 's Grand Jump magazine in December 2013. The manga then moved to Captain Tsubasa Magazine , Grand Jump 's spinoff magazine that focuses on the franchise, when it launched in April 2020.

Captain Tsubasa: Rising Sun The Final , the "final saga" of the overall Captain Tsubasa series, launched in Captain Tsubasa Magazine in April 2023. The manga ended in April 2024 alongside an announcement that Takahashi would retire from serializing manga. A new Captain Tsubasa: Rising Sun Finals manga continues the story in storyboard form on the franchise's website .

Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service added all chapters of Takahashi's original Captain Tsubasa manga in English in April 2025. This is the first time the manga got a solo English release. A bilingual edition in Japanese and English was released for the "eOneBook" reader device in September 2020.
